preview.note: Attach only. Never rebuild, never restart, never take ownership.

entry.fixtureLabel: LABELLED DIAGNOSTIC FIXTURE: deep labelled entry, reusing the existing successful movie survey prerequisite ONLY to reach a safe grounded E. It is NOT full-story continuity, NOT an earned Continue, NOT first-time naive UX, and grants no acceptance.
entry.lane: MANUAL — ordinary held WASD only. No movie=1 during the measured leg, no autopilot, no teleport, no forced click, no rail-derived target.
entry.reusedPath: verifier/probes/arrival-common-manual/common-passage-probe.mjs preparation + physics path and entryObservation.mjs, unmodified and not edited by this commission.

groundingCorrection.priorDefect: The previous manual reference-3 E entry was AIRBORNE because of a direct W->E shortcut (at-E footY 53.317, unsupported).
groundingCorrection.action: Do NOT repeat the direct W->E shortcut and do NOT describe that entry as grounded. Require ground.isSupported at E to be observed true before the first measured update; if it is not, stop and report, do not proceed.

measuredLeg.scope: Bounded positive vertex 2 -> 3 -> 4 crossing ONLY. Not the full eighteen-unit route.
measuredLeg.input: Ordinary held WASD, >=30ms pulses, no sub-frame steering requirement.

discriminator.intent: Cross vertex 2's incoming plane with an ORDINARY eligible POSITIVE post-plane overshoot (target residual 0.10-0.20 units past the vertex on its incoming axis, i.e. the ordinary shape the manual run actually produced), then continue over vertex 3 and vertex 4.
discriminator.doNotSubstitute: MUST NOT be replaced by a before-plane / squared-corner target. Silently switching the target invalidates the discriminator.

control.intent: Same leg with the corner residual kept BEHIND the vertex, matching the passing long run's continuous-arc shape.
control.status: DIAGNOSTIC CONTROL ONLY — not a usability standard, not authority to impose that precision, not a passing manual result.

measuredLeg.onlyOnePair: Exactly one discriminator and one control. No broader suite is proposed.

instrumentation.mechanism: CDP Debugger.setBreakpointByUrl with a condition that records bounded data and evaluates to false
instrumentation.expectedVolume: ~60 records/s while stage==='holding-h'; the bounded vertex 2->4 leg is ~6-10s, so ~360-600 records, well inside the cap. Drops are counted, never silently discarded.
instrumentation.drain: single Runtime.evaluate at end of leg

flags.plannedRunner: NOT WRITTEN — no runner is provided, because running requires a browser attach that this commission forbids.

timingIdentityEffect.identity: Setting a conditional breakpoint does NOT change the bundle bytes; the served file and its sha256 efc87feb0068671e6ac297f808fe61ea320b208a13fd9a8c40fa051077a9a068 are untouched. V8 deoptimises and re-JITs the patched function, so `pwe` runs interpreted/less-optimised for the session.
timingIdentityEffect.timing: Each condition evaluation costs roughly single-digit microseconds and runs once per director update inside tickCommon. This can lengthen a frame slightly and therefore slightly change dt and per-update displacement. Displacement is MEASURED, not assumed, so the recorded per-update displacement remains the actual one; but the DISTRIBUTION of displacements is not guaranteed identical to an uninstrumented session, and any near-ceiling comparison must state that.
timingIdentityEffect.noObserverCredit: The sink is a plain array on globalThis; nothing reads it back into game state, so it cannot influence credit.

fallbackIfBindingUnreliable.status: NOT NEEDED — binding verified unique and exact; no instrumentation-only source patch is proposed or staged.
